must.description: The <h:commandButton id="subscribe"> in index.xhtml sits outside every UIForm, so its action is never invoked.
The <h:inputText id="email"> in index.xhtml has no <h:message for="email">, so its conversion and validation messages are never displayed.
The <h:inputText value="#{registrationBean.name}"> in index.xhtml has no explicit id and therefore gets a generated one; it should be id="name" after the property.
The <c:if test="#{registrationBean.newsletterEnabled}"> in index.xhtml uses JSTL to conditionally render rather than build the view; it should be the rendered attribute instead.
The <h:outputText> in index.xhtml carries an inline style attribute instead of a CSS class.
templates/layout.xhtml lives in the webapp root instead of /WEB-INF/templates/, so it is reachable at its own URL. Reported as an error.
RegistrationBean.init() backs the <h:selectManyCheckbox> topics property with List.of(), an immutable list, which throws UnsupportedOperationException when Faces populates it during decode.
RegistrationBean.getAvailableTopics() lazy-loads from TopicService inside the getter instead of initializing in @PostConstruct.

resources/components/topicPicker.xhtml is a composite component in the default resources directory instead of /WEB-INF/resources/, where it would need jakarta.faces.WEBAPP_RESOURCES_DIRECTORY set to WEB-INF/resources. Reported as a warning.

must_not.description: Proposes converting the plain Faces components to passthrough elements, or otherwise nudges the project toward the passthrough markup style.
Proposes removing or changing immediate="true" on the <h:inputText id="username"> in the login form.

Recommends an API introduced after Faces 4.1 (a Faces 5.0 feature such as CDI @Observes phase events, the placeholder attribute, ENABLE_CSP_NONCE, or the FacesMessage.Severity enum) as an error-level or warning-level fix rather than as an explicitly version-labelled info note.

Advises moving the composite or the stylesheet into /WEB-INF/resources/ without also setting jakarta.faces.WEBAPP_RESOURCES_DIRECTORY, or advises setting that context-param without also moving the files.
Claims the raw Facelets source of layout.xhtml or topicPicker.xhtml can be downloaded, even though web.xml maps FacesServlet to *.xhtml, which makes those files processed rather than served.
